name: GPU fan curve + power profiles (powos-gpu-fan)
hostNote: gpu-195 (192.168.50.195, Bazzite 44 nvidia-open, 2x ASUS RTX 3090 blowers 1043:87b3)
purpose: Quiet the blower 3090s: the vBIOS curve holds 53-77% fan at idle. Leaves the vBIOS fan-stop (0% when cool) alone; never wakes a stopped fan; takes over when the vBIOS spins faster than the curve at >=52 C, or when the vBIOS spins >15 points above the curve (the post-load linger), with an NVML (ctypes, no extra packages) curve 30% at 50 C up to 100% at 83 C, immediate up, 2%/tick down with 3 C hysteresis; hands back at <=47 C for 30 s; 250 W power cap per card (default 350). Any NVML error, exit, or >=87 C hands the card back to its vBIOS curve; stop restores default power limits. Power profiles per card (11-09): busy 250 W uncapped clocks; idle (util <= 2% for 60 s) 150 W + graphics clock capped 210-1000 MHz; mode auto/quiet/performance in /etc/powos/gpu-fan-mode.
decide: Tune with /etc/powos/gpu-fan.json (curve, power_limit_w, panic_c), then sudo systemctl restart powos-gpu-fan. Status without root: python3 /usr/local/bin/powos-gpu-fan status. Power mode: sudo powos-gpu-fan mode auto|quiet|performance (powos-gpu-fan mode shows it).
